title: Time the untimed seeding work and rename MmseqsTimed to SeedTimed
body:
Seeding's [misc.] was 19 s on a full Pfam against one MGnify shard, because writing the mmseqs query and target databases (mmseqs.rs:433-575, called from seed_stage.rs:42-50 and 128-136) and the prog-mode slicing, deciding and merging (seed_stage.rs:115-369) have no variant.

Add DbWrite, and for prog mode Slice, Decide and Merge, so [misc.] shrinks to noise. Rename the enum to SeedTimed, since half of it is no longer an mmseqs call, and drop '(mmseqs)' from the branch label.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text: Committed on runtime-tree. Timers verified by reading the diff only: every new timer is on an mmseqs code path and mmseqs is not installed on this machine. First real prog-mode run should check that seeding's [misc.] is now small.
